$comment: apps/web standalone program (WR-E1). The root tsconfig.json does not
include apps/web (its include list is not this file's to extend), so this
program is self-contained: same compilerOptions as the root program
(inherited via extends), which is the exact option set the desktop form
is compiled under — the compile-time same-shape guarantee. The whole
@datazen/frontend source graph is pulled in through the package exports
(source-package mode: consumers import TypeScript directly), so this
program typechecks the web assembly against every port the desktop
assembly binds.
types adds 'vite/client' on top of the root's list: the frontend's own
vite-env.d.ts ambient augmentation is NOT part of this program (it is
picked up by the root program's include globs, never by imports), so
import.meta.env — used by packages/frontend's env.ts and bootstrap —
needs the Vite contract here.
TypeScript 7 does not auto-discover node_modules/@types; the 'node' /
'react' / 'react-dom' entries reproduce the root program's set and
resolve from the workspace root's node_modules/@types (apps/web declares
no @types of its own, mirroring apps/desktop). See the root tsconfig.json
for the full maintenance rule.
The exclude keeps the guards' throwaway probe files out of this program
(same pattern as the root tsconfig.json and packages/backend-client).
